import pathlib, zipfile, subprocess, textwrap, shutil, os
base=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\geodata')
zp=base/'produtos_mde_salvador_ba.zip'
out=base/'sgb_mde_salvador'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(zp,'r') as z:
    for info in z.infolist():
        if info.filename.startswith('MDE/mde/') and not info.is_dir():
            z.extract(info,out)
grid=out/'MDE'/'mde'
uv=shutil.which('uv') or r'C:\Users\TONECOS\.local\bin\uv.exe'
script=base/'sample_sgb_dem.py'
script.write_text(textwrap.dedent(r'''
import rasterio
from pyproj import Transformer
from pathlib import Path

grid=Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\geodata\sgb_mde_salvador\MDE\mde')
origin_lon=-38.5129247
origin_lat=-12.9745411
# Blender/project local coordinates are X east, Y north, in metres.
points_local={
 'ORIGIN_PROJECT':(0.0,0.0),
 'LOW_ACCESS_PISO':(-40.431,43.761),
 'TOWER_HEAD_CENTER':(-47.1903,50.1044),
 'HIGH_ENTRY_PISO':(-2.5779,8.2384),
 'HIGH_GALLERY':(-5.2817,10.7757),
}
with rasterio.open(grid) as ds:
    print('DRIVER',ds.driver)
    print('CRS',ds.crs)
    print('SIZE',ds.width,ds.height)
    print('RES',ds.res)
    print('BOUNDS',tuple(round(v,3) for v in ds.bounds))
    print('NODATA',ds.nodata)
    to_ds=Transformer.from_crs('EPSG:4326',ds.crs,always_xy=True)
    ox,oy=to_ds.transform(origin_lon,origin_lat)
    print('ORIGIN_DATASET_XY',round(ox,3),round(oy,3))
    coords=[]; names=[]
    for name,(x,y) in points_local.items():
        px,py=ox+x,oy+y
        names.append(name); coords.append((px,py))
    vals=list(ds.sample(coords))
    for name,(px,py),v in zip(names,coords,vals):
        val=float(v[0])
        print('SAMPLE',name,'XY',round(px,3),round(py,3),'Z',round(val,3))
'''),encoding='utf-8')
cmd=[uv,'run','--with','rasterio','--with','pyproj','python',str(script)]
print('RUN',cmd)
r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
print('RETURN',r.returncode)
print('STDOUT\n'+r.stdout)
print('STDERR\n'+r.stderr)
if r.returncode!=0: raise RuntimeError('uv raster sampling failed')
